entries.en: You can run in through the side door if it rains.
entries.zh: 如果下雨，你可以从侧门跑进去。

entries.en: We've nearly run out of thread for the curtains.
entries.zh: 我们做窗帘的线快用完了。

entries.en: The volunteers began to run out of steam after midnight.
entries.zh: 午夜过后，志愿者们开始精疲力竭了。

entries.en: She promised she would never run out on her children.
entries.zh: 她答应绝不会抛弃自己的孩子。

entries.en: Without regular pruning, the climbing roses can run riot.
entries.zh: 如果不定期修剪，这些攀缘蔷薇就会长得过于茂盛。

entries.en: The proposal will have to run the gauntlet of a hostile committee.
entries.zh: 这份提案将不得不经受一个抱有敌意的委员会的严厉批评。

entries.en: The repair costs could run to several thousand pounds.
entries.zh: 维修费用可能达到几千英镑。

entries.en: We left some lettuces to run to seed beside the fence.
entries.zh: 我们把几株莴苣留在围栏旁，让它们结子。

entries.en: The builders might run up against old foundations beneath the yard.
entries.zh: 施工人员可能会意外碰到院子下面的旧地基。

entries.en: Please don't rush through the final checks to catch your train.
entries.zh: 请不要为了赶火车而草草完成最后的检查。

entries.en: The old iron hinges could rust away in that damp shed.
entries.zh: 那些旧铁铰链在潮湿的棚屋里可能会锈蚀掉。

entries.en: I'll rustle up a quick supper while you unpack.
entries.zh: 你整理行李时，我来赶快弄点晚饭。

entries.en: We need to saddle up the horses before sunrise.
entries.zh: 日出前，我们得给马套上鞍。

entries.en: Misleading advertisements can make a company sail close to the wind.
entries.zh: 误导性的广告可能使一家公司游走在违规的边缘。

entries.en: We'll scale back the catering if fewer guests confirm.
entries.zh: 如果确认出席的客人减少，我们就相应缩减餐饮安排。

entries.en: The report accused management of scapegoating the youngest workers.
entries.zh: 报告指责管理层让最年轻的工人充当替罪羊。

entries.en: I can probably scare up a simple supper from the leftovers.
entries.zh: 我大概能用剩菜凑合出一顿简单的晚饭。

entries.en: They sent a small patrol to scout out the valley.
entries.zh: 他们派一支小巡逻队去侦察山谷。

entries.en: Without a calculator, I could only scrape through the arithmetic test.
entries.zh: 没有计算器，我只能勉强通过算术测验。

entries.en: We had to scrape together enough coins for the parking meter.
entries.zh: 我们不得不勉强凑足付停车计时器的钱币。

entries.en: One afternoon can only scratch the surface of this enormous archive.
entries.zh: 一个下午只能让人对这个庞大的档案馆浅尝即止。

entries.en: Use this strip of tape to seal up the envelope.
entries.zh: 用这条胶带把信封密封住。

entries.en: She hopes to search out the original plans in the town archive.
entries.zh: 她希望在镇档案馆里找到原始图纸。

entries.en: I'll see about the broken window after the visitors leave.
entries.zh: 访客离开后，我会处理那扇破窗户。

entries.en: We went to the harbour to see off our visiting friends.
entries.zh: 我们去港口为来访的朋友们送行。

entries.en: Could you see to the lighting while I arrange the chairs?
entries.zh: 我摆椅子时，你能负责照明吗？

entries.en: My mother used to send away for seeds every spring.
entries.zh: 我的母亲过去每年春天都会函购种子。

entries.en: The catalogue explains how to send off for replacement parts.
entries.zh: 目录说明了如何函购替换零件。

entries.en: The children watched the crew send up a weather balloon.
entries.zh: 孩子们看着工作人员放起一个气象气球。

entries.en: We'll serve out the soup once everyone has a bowl.
entries.zh: 等每个人都有碗了，我们再分汤。

entries.en: The extra income can be set against the higher rent.
entries.zh: 增加的收入可以用来抵消上涨的租金。

entries.en: A spark from the stove set fire to the curtain.
entries.zh: 炉子里的一颗火星点燃了窗帘。

entries.en: My father taught me to set great store by keeping promises.
entries.zh: 父亲教导我要极重视信守承诺。

entries.en: Someone had set light to the rubbish behind the shed.
entries.zh: 有人点燃了棚屋后面的垃圾。

entries.en: Her first donation helped set the ball rolling for the fundraiser.
entries.zh: 她的第一笔捐款帮助募捐活动启动起来。

entries.en: The opening speech should set the scene for a practical discussion.
entries.zh: 开场发言应该为务实讨论做好准备。

entries.en: The baker plans to set up shop near the station.
entries.zh: 那位面包师打算在车站附近开店。

entries.en: The detective suspected that the attack was meant to settle a score.
entries.zh: 侦探怀疑，这次袭击是为了报复。

entries.en: We wanted a balcony but had to settle for a larger window.
entries.zh: 我们想要阳台，却不得不满足于一扇较大的窗户。

entries.en: It took the twins a week to settle in at their new flat.
entries.zh: 那对双胞胎花了一周才在新公寓安顿下来。

entries.en: Let's settle up with the caterer before everyone leaves.
entries.zh: 我们在大家离开前和餐饮承办人结清款项吧。

entries.en: I need to sew up the torn pocket before washing this coat.
entries.zh: 洗这件外套之前，我得把撕破的口袋缝好。

entries.en: The model smiled sexily at the camera for the perfume advertisement.
entries.zh: 为拍香水广告，那位模特对着镜头露出了性感的笑容。

entries.en: We used a long pole to shake down the remaining apples.
entries.zh: 我们用一根长杆摇落剩下的苹果。

entries.en: Take the rug outside and shake out the sand.
entries.zh: 把地毯拿到外面，抖出里面的沙子。

entries.meaningZh: 不会〔shall not 的缩写，主要英式〕
entries.en: I shan't be home before the last bus leaves.
entries.zh: 末班车开走之前，我不会到家。

entries.en: Everyone agreed to share in the cost of repairing the roof.
entries.zh: 大家同意分担修理屋顶的费用。

entries.en: The teacher will share out the remaining paper among the groups.
entries.zh: 老师会把剩下的纸分给各小组。

entries.en: We cannot shilly-shally when the application deadline is so close.
entries.zh: 申请截止日期已经这么近了，我们不能再犹豫不决。

entries.en: The warehouse will ship out the replacement chairs on Monday.
entries.zh: 仓库会在周一运出替换用的椅子。

entries.en: It pays to shop around before buying an expensive bicycle.
entries.zh: 购买昂贵的自行车之前，逐店比较选购是值得的。

entries.en: The cashier had short-changed several customers before the manager noticed.
entries.zh: 经理察觉之前，收银员已故意少找了几位顾客的零钱。

entries.en: The passengers stood shoulder to shoulder on the crowded platform.
entries.zh: 乘客们肩并肩地站在拥挤的站台上。

entries.en: The grapes shrivelled in the bowl while we were away.
entries.zh: 我们不在的时候，碗里的葡萄变干瘪了。

entries.en: The rider sat side-saddle as the horse moved slowly.
entries.zh: 马缓缓前行时，骑手偏坐在马鞍上。

entries.en: She managed to sidefoot the ball past the goalkeeper.
entries.zh: 她设法用脚侧把球踢过了守门员。

entries.en: Someone must sign for the parcel when it arrives.
entries.zh: 包裹到达时，必须有人签收。

entries.en: The new recruits were left to sink or swim without any training.
entries.zh: 新来的人没有得到任何培训，只能全靠自己，成败自负。

entries.en: We can't just sit about while the roof is leaking.
entries.zh: 屋顶正在漏水，我们不能光坐着不干。

entries.en: The trainee asked to sit in on the budget meeting.
entries.zh: 那位受训者请求旁听预算会议。

entries.en: The director cannot sit on this complaint for another month.
entries.zh: 主管不能再把这起投诉压着拖延一个月。

entries.en: You can't sit on the fence when both sides need your answer.
entries.zh: 双方都需要你的答复时，你不能保持中立。

entries.en: I could barely sit through the film's endless final scene.
entries.zh: 电影的最后一场戏没完没了，我几乎无法耐着性子看完。

entries.en: I'll sketch in the background once the figures are finished.
entries.zh: 人物画好之后，我会粗略地添上背景。

entries.en: Could you sketch out a timetable before the next meeting?
entries.zh: 你能在下次会议之前草拟一份时间表吗？

entries.en: The new bus stop is slap bang outside our front door.
entries.zh: 新公交车站恰好就在我们家门外。

entries.meaningZh: 把问题留到第二天解决
entries.en: You needn't decide tonight; take the contract home and sleep on it.
entries.zh: 你不必今晚决定；把合同带回家，留到明天再考虑。

entries.en: I was so tired I managed to sleep through breakfast.
entries.zh: 我太累了，竟然睡过头，错过了早饭。

entries.en: A small cat could slip through that gap in the fence.
entries.zh: 一只小猫可以从围栏的那个缺口悄悄钻过去。

entries.en: The driver always slows down near the school entrance.
entries.zh: 司机总会在学校入口附近减速。

entries.en: Exhausted after the long walk, he slurred his final few words.
entries.zh: 长途步行后，他筋疲力尽，含糊地说出了最后几个词。

entries.en: Small wonder she missed the train after leaving so late.
entries.zh: 她出发那么晚，难怪没赶上火车。

entries.en: When the signatures failed to match, I began to smell a rat.
entries.zh: 签名对不上时，我开始感到不妙。

entries.en: The kitten tried to sneak up on the pigeon beneath the bench.
entries.zh: 小猫想悄悄靠近长椅下面的鸽子。

entries.en: Reporters began to sniff around the abandoned factory after the discovery.
entries.zh: 有所发现后，记者们开始在废弃的工厂四处探寻。

entries.en: She sniffily dismissed the suggestion that they travel by coach.
entries.zh: 她不屑地否定了乘长途客车出行的建议。

entries.en: We were snowed in at the cottage for two days.
entries.zh: 我们被雪困在小屋里两天。

entries.en: Why does that tiny replacement part cost so much?
entries.zh: 那个小小的替换零件为什么要花那么多钱？

entries.en: He left without so much as a glance at the ruined garden.
entries.zh: 他离开时甚至没有看一眼毁坏的花园。

entries.en: He told the heckler to sod off and let others speak.
entries.zh: 他叫那个起哄的人滚开，让别人说话。

entries.en: The probe made a soft landing on the dusty surface.
entries.zh: 探测器在布满尘土的表面实现了软着陆。

entries.en: Warm water should soften up the dried glue on the brush.
entries.zh: 温水应该能软化刷子上干掉的胶水。

entries.en: The bakery had sold out of fresh rolls before noon.
entries.zh: 不到中午，面包店就卖光了新鲜小面包。

entries.en: Despite the missing equipment, the volunteers decided to soldier on.
entries.zh: 尽管设备短缺，志愿者们仍决定迎着困难坚持干下去。

entries.en: I hope to return to that quiet harbour some day.
entries.zh: 我希望将来有一天能重返那个宁静的港口。

entries.en: Somehow or other, the envelope ended up in my coat pocket.
entries.zh: 不知怎的，那个信封最后到了我的外套口袋里。

entries.en: That old engine sounds something like a distant drum.
entries.zh: 那台老引擎的声音有几分像远处的鼓声。

entries.en: Sooner or later, someone will notice the missing page.
entries.zh: 迟早会有人注意到少了那一页。

entries.en: The guidebook authors speak highly of the village museum.
entries.zh: 旅游指南的作者们对村里的博物馆评价很高。

entries.en: She would never speak ill of her rivals in public.
entries.zh: 她从不愿在公开场合说竞争对手的坏话。

entries.en: People who worked with him still speak well of him.
entries.zh: 和他共事过的人至今仍说他的好话。

entries.en: Speaking of bicycles, did you collect yours from the repair shop?
entries.zh: 说到自行车，你从修理店取回你的那辆了吗？

entries.en: Please spellcheck the invitation before sending it to the printer.
entries.zh: 请先用拼写检查程序检查邀请函，再把它送去印刷。

entries.en: They decided to splash out on a suite for their anniversary.
entries.zh: 他们决定在周年纪念日大花一笔，住一间套房。

entries.en: A small group decided to split off from the main expedition.
entries.zh: 一个小组决定脱离远征队主队。

entries.en: We agreed to split the difference and meet at half past three.
entries.zh: 我们同意折中，在三点半见面。

entries.en: He learned to spoon-feed the baby without spilling the porridge.
entries.zh: 他学会了用勺子喂婴儿，而不把粥洒出来。

entries.en: The technician spotlit the empty chair before the actor entered.
entries.zh: 演员登场前，技术员用聚光灯照亮了那把空椅子。

entries.en: The soldier managed to squeeze off a shot before retreating.
entries.zh: 那名士兵在撤退前设法扣动扳机开了一枪。

entries.en: The candidate hired advisers to stage-manage the televised debate.
entries.zh: 候选人聘请顾问，在幕后安排和指挥电视辩论。

entries.en: The surveyors will stake out the new path across the field.
entries.zh: 测量员会立桩标出穿过田野的新路。

entries.en: Don't stamp on the seedlings beside the steps.
entries.zh: 别踩踏台阶旁边的幼苗。

entries.en: Please stand aside so the stretcher can pass.
entries.zh: 请站到一旁，让担架通过。

entries.en: The cadets were told to stand at attention during the inspection.
entries.zh: 学员们被要求在检查期间立正。

entries.en: The chair intends to stand down after the annual meeting.
entries.zh: 主席打算在年会之后退出职务。

entries.en: The young musicians still stand in awe of their demanding conductor.
entries.zh: 年轻的乐手们仍然敬畏那位要求严格的指挥。

entries.en: Could you stand in for the receptionist during her lunch break?
entries.zh: 接待员午休时，你能暂时代替她吗？

entries.en: Visitors must stand in line outside the ticket office.
entries.zh: 访客必须在售票处外排队。

entries.en: A missing signature could stand in the way of the sale.
entries.zh: 缺少一个签名可能会阻碍这笔交易。

entries.en: The guards began to stand to attention as the officer approached.
entries.zh: 军官走近时，卫兵们开始立正。

entries.en: You should stand up for colleagues who are treated unfairly.
entries.zh: 你应该维护受到不公平对待的同事。

entries.en: These boots should stand up to another winter of muddy walks.
entries.zh: 这双靴子应该经得起再一个冬天在泥路上行走。

entries.en: We'll start off before dawn to avoid the worst traffic.
entries.zh: 我们会在黎明前出发，避开最拥堵的时候。

entries.en: Can you start on cleaning the windows while I sweep?
entries.zh: 我扫地时，你能开始擦窗户吗？

entries.en: The spoiled photograph meant we had to start over.
entries.zh: 照片毁了，这意味着我们得重新开始。

entries.en: Would you start the ball rolling with your account of yesterday's museum visit?
entries.zh: 你愿意先讲讲昨天参观博物馆的情况，带头发言吗？

entries.en: Please stay clear of the loose stones near the cliff.
entries.zh: 请不要靠近悬崖附近松动的石头。

entries.en: We decided to stay in and repair the broken shelf.
entries.zh: 我们决定待在家里修理坏掉的架子。

entries.en: The children wanted to stay out until the stars appeared.
entries.zh: 孩子们想待在户外，直到星星出现。

entries.en: The restoration is slow, but we intend to stay the course.
entries.zh: 修复工作进展缓慢，但我们打算坚持到底。

entries.en: She tried to steal a glance at the clock behind him.
entries.zh: 她想偷看一眼他身后的钟。

entries.en: The hot shower began to steam up the bathroom mirror.
entries.zh: 热水淋浴开始让浴室镜子蒙上水汽。

entries.en: Cyclists should steer clear of the deep pothole near the bend.
entries.zh: 骑车人应该绕开弯道附近的深坑。

entries.en: The porter asked us to step aside for the delivery trolley.
entries.zh: 搬运工让我们避到一旁，给送货手推车让路。

entries.en: Everyone had to step back when the hot door opened.
entries.zh: 那扇滚烫的门打开时，所有人都得后退。

entries.en: When the cook fell ill, her neighbour offered to step into the breach.
entries.zh: 厨师病倒后，她的邻居主动提出临时补缺。

entries.en: The driving instructor told me not to step on the gas yet.
entries.zh: 驾驶教练告诉我先别踩油门。

entries.en: If you stick at the violin exercises, the difficult passages become easier.
entries.zh: 如果你坚持做这些小提琴练习，难演奏的乐段就会变得容易些。

entries.en: Those clumsy alterations will stick out a mile in daylight.
entries.zh: 那些笨拙的改动在日光下会显而易见。

entries.en: The tenants decided to stick out for a written guarantee.
entries.zh: 租户们决定坚持索取书面保证。

entries.en: She was willing to stick up for the unfairly criticised apprentice.
entries.zh: 她愿意维护那个受到不公正批评的学徒。

entries.en: I'll stitch up the torn lining before returning your jacket.
entries.zh: 把夹克还给你之前，我会把撕破的衬里缝好。

entries.meaningZh: 被偷窃〔steal 的过去分词〕
entries.en: The painting had been stolen before the exhibition opened.
entries.zh: 展览开幕之前，那幅画就已经被偷走了。

entries.en: Please stop by the workshop if you're near the harbour.
entries.zh: 如果你来到港口附近，请顺便到作坊看看。

entries.en: We could stop off at the village bakery on our way home.
entries.zh: 回家途中，我们可以在村里的面包店停留一下。

entries.en: The family began to store up firewood before the first frost.
entries.zh: 初霜到来之前，这家人开始储存柴火。

entries.en: Tell the caretaker straight away if the gate won't lock.
entries.zh: 如果大门锁不上，请立即告诉管理员。

entries.en: The organiser agreed to stretch a point and admit one late entry.
entries.zh: 组织者同意破例接受一份迟交的参赛作品。

entries.en: The campaign aims to strike a blow for equal access to education.
entries.zh: 这场运动旨在为平等接受教育的机会而奋斗。

entries.en: Researchers can strike gold in a box of overlooked letters.
entries.zh: 研究人员可能会在一盒被忽视的信件里发现大量有价值的信息。

entries.en: The prospectors hoped to strike it rich beyond the northern ridge.
entries.zh: 探矿者希望能在北面的山脊那边发现丰富的矿藏。

entries.en: We might strike lucky and find an empty cottage tonight.
entries.zh: 今晚我们也许能交上好运，找到一间空着的小屋。

entries.en: The restorer will strip away the later layers of paint.
entries.zh: 修复人员会去掉后来刷上的几层油漆。

entries.en: He hurried to strip off his wet coat before entering the kitchen.
entries.zh: 进厨房前，他急忙脱掉湿外套。

entries.en: The workers vowed to struggle on until their demands were heard.
entries.zh: 工人们发誓要斗争下去，直到他们的诉求得到倾听。

entries.meaningZh: 因吸毒而身体虚弱的〔非正式〕
entries.en: In the novel, the drug addict looks strung out and refuses the offered meal.
entries.zh: 小说中，那个吸毒成瘾的人看上去身体虚弱，并拒绝了别人提供的饭食。

entries.en: The jeweller studded the buckle with tiny blue gemstones.
entries.zh: 珠宝匠在搭扣上镶嵌了细小的蓝色宝石。

entries.en: You might stumble across the missing receipt while sorting these papers.
entries.zh: 整理这些纸张时，你可能会偶然发现那张丢失的收据。

entries.en: We didn't expect to stumble on a ruined chapel during our walk.
entries.zh: 我们没想到散步时会无意中发现一座废弃的小教堂。

entries.meaningZh: 拿出所需的钱〔英式非正式〕
entries.en: Each club member agreed to stump up for a replacement kettle.
entries.zh: 每位俱乐部成员都同意出钱买一个替换用的水壶。

entries.en: The final revelation stupefied even the detective who had gathered the evidence.
entries.zh: 最后揭露的真相甚至让那位收集证据的侦探都惊呆了。

entries.en: The claim remains subject to verification by an independent examiner.
entries.zh: 这一说法仍有待独立审核员查实。

entries.en: No amount of glossy publicity could sugar the pill of factory closures.
entries.zh: 再多华丽的宣传也粉饰不了工厂关闭这件事。

entries.en: He tried to summon up the courage to challenge the decision.
entries.zh: 他试图鼓起勇气，对那个决定提出异议。

entries.en: She sussed out the trick before the second demonstration.
entries.zh: 第二次演示前，她就推断出了其中的把戏。

entries.en: The gardener continues to swear by her old pruning shears.
entries.zh: 那位园丁始终信赖她那把旧修枝剪。

entries.en: The young designer hopes to sweep the board at the awards ceremony.
entries.zh: 年轻的设计师希望在颁奖典礼上大获全胜。

entries.en: The manager tried to sweeten the pill by describing the cuts as an opportunity.
entries.zh: 经理把削减说成一种机遇，试图粉饰这件事。

entries.en: The applause began to tail away as the audience left.
entries.zh: 随着观众离去，掌声开始减弱。

entries.meaningZh: 交通堵塞排成长队〔英式〕
entries.en: Traffic may tail back beyond the bridge during the repairs.
entries.zh: 修缮期间，车辆可能会堵塞排成长队，一直排到桥外。

entries.en: Orders tend to tail off once the holiday season ends.
entries.zh: 节假日期间一结束，订单往往就会减少。

entries.en: He was content to take a back seat during the negotiations.
entries.zh: 谈判期间，他甘愿处于次要地位。

entries.en: The kitten might take a fancy to that empty cardboard box.
entries.zh: 小猫也许会喜欢上那个空纸箱。

entries.en: Please take a seat while I fetch the application form.
entries.zh: 我去取申请表时，请先坐下。

entries.en: The timetable must take account of the ferry's winter schedule.
entries.zh: 这份时间表必须考虑渡轮的冬季班次。

entries.en: We can take advantage of the empty room for rehearsals.
entries.zh: 我们可以利用那个空房间进行排练。

entries.en: My cousin will take care of the cats while we're away.
entries.zh: 我们不在的时候，我的一位堂表亲会照顾这些猫。

entries.en: The report must take cognizance of objections from nearby residents.
entries.zh: 报告必须注意到附近居民提出的反对意见。

entries.en: The sudden hail forced the walkers to take cover beneath a bridge.
entries.zh: 突如其来的冰雹迫使步行者躲到一座桥下。
